verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out setting, flag, or environment variable for Letta. The local and self-hosted modes keep agent state on-device and need no Letta account, but that concerns where data is stored, not a control for disabling telemetry. It is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
